utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam, I've been meaning to ask — did you hear how that repair drive went last week? I keep getting mixed details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, hey Jules! I was actually helping load up a bunch of stuff for it. Folks donated old electronics, tools, the works — seemed like a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's great to hear! I've been trying to piece together what actually happened with it — was it for the console repair or something else?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive! Saturday... that's this Saturday, isn't it? I think I put my screwdriver set aside for it somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like we're both scrambling to remember—Saturday's sneaking up on us, isn't it?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ha, yeah, it sure is! I swear I had my wrench in my hand just a minute ago... or was that yesterday?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Faye, have you heard more about this repair drive? I'm trying to figure out what it's all about.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Still waiting on the exact start time—I'm juggling soccer games that day, so I'm hoping we get the details soon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, so it's definitely happening then? I just keep catching scraps of info—sounds like Uli might be helping out after the weekend.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help after the weekend too, Dane — whenever it works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I'm thinking Saturday morning works best for me — I'll grab those supplies first thing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Saturday morning sounds good — I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'd like to know when we're expected to have those tools ready. Can we set a clear time?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, is the repair drive actually confirmed for Saturday? I've heard a few different dates floating around.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I was told Saturday, and I'd like to stick to that plan. Can we nail that down?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Need any tools for the repair drive? I've got a full set in my garage if you need to borrow anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I heard something about that. Hope it works out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Well, I'm ready to lend a hand or a wrench whenever you need it. Just give me a shout.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Quinn, I'm still trying to piece together what this repair drive's all about. You heard anything solid?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh absolutely! It's this Saturday morning, rain or shine—we're fixing up bikes for the kids. I've been telling everyone to come lend a hand!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Huh, bikes, huh? That's good—simple and solid. I'm pretty handy with tools, so I could probably help out if you need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Need any tools for the repair drive? Gus offered his set.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, thanks Leo! Do you know if the repair drive is at the old garage or the new one? I keep getting mixed signals.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I think it's the old garage. Gus mentioned his tools there earlier.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I heard, Quinn. But are we sure everyone can make it? I don't want to start without a full count.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's a good point, Pia. Let me check my list—I think most folks are okay with the switch, but I'll follow up with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa. I just want to make sure we have enough hands and tools before we dive in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: So Noah, it's definitely this weekend — Rosa confirmed it. I'm bringing my lawnmower, and Rey has a socket wrench set from Gus.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, this weekend? I keep mixing things up—thanks for clarifying.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem, Noah! So I'll see you there with my lawnmower, and Rey's bringing that socket wrench set from Gus.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, do you know when we're actually starting the repair drive, or is it still up in the air?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We're still collecting parts and supplies, so no firm date yet. Got any old electronics or spare parts you can spare?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I might have some old cables and a broken radio—will those help, or do you need something more specific?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait—are you talking about the community bike repair event, or the tool we used on the console last week? I want to make sure I'm following you correctly.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the community bike repair, sweetie! The one down at the old garage—they're sprucing up bicycles for the kiddos this Saturday, rain or shine!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Ah, got it—the bike repair event. I was mixing it up with something else. So what's the plan for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Leo, did you hear about the repair drive this weekend? I'm planning to bring my old lawnmower.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I heard. Need a hand with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That would be great! Gus said he has tools if we need them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive! Yes, it's this Saturday morning, rain or shine. Quinn told me all about it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, this Saturday! Right, I think I remember now. Thanks, Oren.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: No problem, Noah! And Quinn said we're fixing up bikes for the kids—should be a good time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I heard something about that. Hope it works out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I'm pitching in to help folks load up donations. You got anything you're looking to give?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hmm, not sure I've got anything handy, but let me check my garage later.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'm sorry, could you clarify which repair drive you mean? The one we used for the console, or a new community event?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, the console one! I thought you meant that—sorry for the mix-up. I know Bo said something about it getting swapped out, but I didn't see what happened myself.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Right, so you're talking about the console repair drive that stopped working mid-repair last week. Did Bo mention what they swapped it with?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Rey, I'm still trying to figure out what this repair drive even is—did anyone tell you what we're supposed to be fixing?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not really, Nell. I've just heard people mention it, but no one's given me a clear picture of what's broken or who's leading it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Well, Gus offered tools and Uli said they can help after the weekend, but I still don't know what we're fixing—so I'm not sure if I should borrow a wrench or a paintbrush, you know?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, I heard about the repair drive this Saturday — I'm planning to drop by after I run a quick errand in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, do you know where it's set up? I'm trying to pin down if it's at the old garage or another spot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I think it's at the old garage — that's where Vik's hauling his lawnmower, at least.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Eli, have you heard about the repair drive? We're collecting old electronics and spare parts to fix up broken tools and appliances.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Cleo. Dane's bringing tools before 1 PM so we can get everything sorted.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, that's perfect timing! Once the tools arrive, we can start sorting through the donations.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Need any tools for the repair drive? I've got a full set in my garage if you need to borrow anything.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Actually, I think we're good now, Gus—your torque wrench and socket set should be just what we need for the kids' bikes. Thanks again for offering!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Happy to help, Mara! Just let me know if anything else comes up—I'll be around if you need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I just wanted to check — are we still on for the repair drive later this week?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Ah, Uli, I'm glad you asked. We actually had to move it to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sunday at the community center, okay. I think I can make that work.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, do you know when we're actually starting the repair drive, or is it still up in the air?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm not comfortable setting a time until I hear back from the others—still waiting on a few confirmations.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, what do you need from me to help get those confirmations?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it's absolutely happening! I saw the flyer at the community center myself — they're collecting bikes at the old garage on Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You're certain it's this Saturday? I haven't seen any flyers myself.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I'm positive! It's bright yellow with big letters — right on the bulletin board next to the sign-up sheet. I can snap a picture for you if you want!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Saw you hauling tools earlier — that repair drive still on for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, it's still set for Saturday! I'm just trying to pin down when exactly it starts so I can juggle it with the kids' soccer schedule.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard Leo was offering to lend a hand — might be worth checking with him for a start time.
